faq.answer: Northstar Service Studio operates Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 in the Europe/Warsaw time zone.
Northstar Service Studio offers three demo services: a 30-minute Introductory Consultation, a 60-minute Standard Service Appointment, and a 90-minute Extended Service Session.
Demo prices are not published in the approved knowledge base. A manager must confirm any price, discount, or commercial condition before booking.
A booking is created only after the customer selects an approved service and time, explicitly confirms the details, and the system checks calendar availability again.
Automatic cancellation and rescheduling are not supported in this demo. A manager must review requests to change or cancel an appointment.
